title: HostDecision
description: Which manager's moment the group screen shows, and who decided. Also the trace for the video and the input to the recap.

source.description: scorer: clear winner, no model call. host: close call settled by the host agent. fallback: host timed out, scorer's pick used.

close_call.description: Whether the scorer had no clear winner. Only a close call's losers count as overruled.

reason.description: Shown on the group screen when source is host.

pitch.description: The manager agent's one-line bid for the group screen.

status.description: How the bid was made: ok, retried after a failed check, or a plain-stat fallback.

pitch_source.description: Who wrote the pitch: manager (the agent) or code (#138).

scores.description: One row per bid that was scored. Declined bids are not scored and do not appear.

knocked_out.description: Set on the decision of the moment that spent a "simulate failure" press (#90): the arm id the chaos endpoint returned, and the one manager whose agent was skipped (absent: every agent).

because.description: Why the host chose. rank_change, differential and captain_swing name a fact kind: the chosen contender's angle must be a fact of that kind, checked by code. bigger_swing, least_airtime, most_close_calls_lost, dead_heat and scorer_pick are scorer reasons from the points and the ledger (#88).

contenders.description: The two pitches the group screen shows on a close call before the verdict (#89). Two different managers; set on every close call settled by the host.
